test_cases.name: MasterCard Credit Purchase/Capture - Manual/Keyed - Purchase approved
MasterCard Credit Purchase/Capture - Manual/Keyed - 3 failed swipes -> keyed entry -> approved

spec_basis.quote: If the device is unable to read the card's magnetic strip, it should prompt the user to swipe the card again-up to three times.
If unable to read the magnetic strip after three attempts, the device should prompt for manual entry of the Account Number and Expiration Date (Format: MMYY).

device_checkpoints: the device asks for a re-swipe after each of the first three failed reads
after the third failed read it prompts for manual entry of Account Number and Expiration Date (MMYY)
the receipt and journal show '*' before the Account Number

test_cases.name: MasterCard Credit Purchase/Capture - Manual/Keyed - Swiped/keyed at RFID-equipped terminal -> approved
test_cases.execution: Terminal has a contactless (RFID) receiver attached and no chip reader; the card is swiped or keyed

spec_basis.quote: Even if the transaction is swiped, manually keyed, or uses a card type for which RFID is not applicable, Point-of-Sale Entry Mode must be populated correctly in the transaction request from the point-of-sale when an RFID receiver is present.
If a Contactless MSR is attached to the POS device and it has no chip capability, then all transactions will use Terminal PIN Entry Capability Mode code 8

test_cases.name: MasterCard Credit Purchase/Capture - Manual/Keyed - Partial approval -> remainder on 2nd card (split tender)

spec_basis.quote: A Response Code (Element No. 83) value of F (Indicates "approval, partial amount approved.")
Partial Approval transactions are supported for: POS Purchase, POS Authorization Only, CAT Authorization Only
Approved Amount (Element No. 6) contains the approved partial amount, and the POS device must prompt for payment of the remaining balance due on the sale.
A Split Tender transaction results when a Partial Approval is returned to the POS in the transaction response.

context_note.reason: that section is about FSA/HRA healthcare benefit cards

runtime.Nonfuel Amount: requested amount (step 1) minus Approved Amount (Element 6) of step 1 response (p.84)

test_cases.name: MasterCard Credit Purchase/Capture - Manual/Keyed - Partial approval -> Purchase Reversal of approved amount

spec_basis.quote: A Response Code (Element No. 83) value of F (Indicates "approval, partial amount approved.")
Partial Approval transactions are supported for: POS Purchase, POS Authorization Only, CAT Authorization Only
The amount in a Reversal (Void) request must be the amount approved in the original transaction response when a transaction has been partially approved.

runtime.Nonfuel Amount: Approved Amount (Element 6) of step 1 partial-approval response (p.84)
